Fabulous rooftop bar in Saigon with a great ambiance
Jan 2025 • Solo
I was so happy to have a couple of Negronis tonight breaking my self enforced sobriety spell at this lovely bar on the 20th floor of the Novotel Saigon Centre.

If I am only going to have a couple of drinks every now and then, then it needs to be in style. This venue oozes a laid back cool style with fabulous night views of the Saigon skyline, and great laid back, chill music that all combine with their heavenly drinks to make you appreciate all the good things in life.

The service is friendly, yet still very professional, I do love that combination. The bar is well stocked, there is also food available. From me, top marks to their mixologist, both Negronis were perfect!

This was my first visit to OnTop, it certainly will not be my last. Next time I will bring a couple of friends with me. Tonight it was just two drinks before dinner. Thank you!

Avoid - you will be scammed. Better happy hours around.
Aug 2018 • Friends
I approach the waiters at the bar and place an order 10 minutes before happy hour ends. I wait 15 minutes and no beer comes. I ask where is my order and they give it to me 5 minutes later.

When I pay for the bill, they charge me full price for the beers. I question this saying I placed my order before happy hour ended, but the manager said the waiter didn’t put the order through and he cannot change the bill now. I said this wasn’t my fault, it was the waiter’s, but the manager insists that I have to pay full price. 

Deliberately didn’t put my order through in order to charge me full price. Avoid the happy hour.
